title: Concerns about Microsoft's Cloud: Growth Deceleration and Leverage Risks Behind Billions in Revenue

content_html:
In today's cloud services market, the arms race among major players is accelerating rapidly. Microsoft achieved its first annual revenue of over $100 billion in the just-completed fiscal year, with a year-over-year growth of 43%. However, this performance does not guarantee peace of mind, as its business growth faces challenges and is even surpassed by with an astonishing growth rate of 82%.

The reason behind this lies in the different paths both giants have chosen in terms of technical approaches and business returns. Google, with its complete ecosystem of self-developed models and chips, has significantly increased its cloud operating profit margin from 20.7% to 35.6%, doubling its profits. In contrast, Microsoft, whose Maia and Cobalt chips are still in early stages, currently relies heavily on commercial chips from NVIDIA. The reselling stack model not only thins its profit structure but also puts more pressure on its computing cost.

At the same time, Microsoft's large order backlog has drawn deep scrutiny from the market. A significant portion of its $67.8 billion in contract backlogs depends on continuous investment from a single client . This highly concentrated client structure and the cycle of capital market lending have raised concerns about potential risks in infrastructure.

Against the backdrop of intensifying industry competition, major cloud providers continue to increase their investments. How to find a balance between aggressive computing power arms race and stable financial health will become key to reshaping the future cloud landscape.

content_html_zh:
在当今的云服务市场，主要参与者之间的军备竞赛正在迅速加速。 微软在刚刚结束的财年首次实现年收入突破1000亿美元，同比增长43%。 但这样的业绩并不能保证安心，业务增长面临挑战，甚至被82%的惊人增速超越。

究其原因，在于两家巨头在技术手段和商业回报上选择的路径不同。 谷歌凭借自研模型和芯片的完整生态系统，云运营利润率从20.7%大幅提升至35.6%，利润翻倍。 相比之下，微软的 Maia 和 Cobalt 芯片仍处于早期阶段，目前严重依赖 NVIDIA 的商业芯片。 倒卖堆栈模式不仅削弱了其利润结构，也给其计算成本带来了更大的压力。

与此同时，微软的大量订单积压也引发了市场的深度审视。 其 678 亿美元的未完成合同中有很大一部分取决于单个客户的持续投资。 这种高度集中的客户结构和资本市场借贷周期引发了人们对基础设施潜在风险的担忧。

在行业竞争加剧的背景下，各大云提供商不断加大投入。 如何在激烈的算力军备竞赛和稳定的财务健康之间找到平衡点，将成为重塑未来云格局的关键。
